architecture.mechanism: Position-sensor-free stop-position control using speed extrema to estimate top dead center for precise engine positioning.
architecture.intervention: Implement a speed-feature-based algorithm in the vehicle battery and engine start system ECU to detect speed extrema during compression, calculate real-time top dead center without dedicated crankshaft sensors, and execute a C¹-continuous quadratic speed trajectory with feedforward torque compensation to ensure accurate engine stop positions that facilitate reliable restarts during thermal events.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of engine reversal and assurance of deterministic engine stop positions, enabling immediate and smooth engine restart to prevent sudden vehicle stall, maintain brake assist pressure, and allow safe egress despite battery thermal fluctuations.
architecture.falsification_test: Induce controlled battery thermal failure in a test vehicle equipped with the modified ECU while monitoring engine stop position accuracy; if the engine fails to restart within 200ms or reverses direction more than zero times across 50 trials, the mechanism is falsified.
